findings.summary: 'Reach the API' step cannot fail because default shell lacks pipefail and curl lacks -f.
findings.fate_evidence: Commit 22cea33d added set -o pipefail and curl -fsSI to fail on non-2xx HTTP responses or broken pipes.

findings.summary: Socket check tests only /var/run/docker.sock, missing Podman, containerd, and rootless sockets.
findings.fate_evidence: Commit 22cea33d updated step to loop over 6 container socket paths including podman, containerd, and XDG_RUNTIME_DIR sockets.

findings.summary: Host-facts step prints uname -a, id, and workdir to world-readable public CI logs daily.
findings.fate_evidence: Commit 22cea33d deleted the Report host facts step entirely.

findings.summary: CI topology documentation lacks explicit runner-group invariant (no pull_request triggers, no untrusted checkouts).
findings.fate_evidence: Commit 22cea33d documented the security invariant in runner-canary.yml header rather than in docs/operations/ci-topology.md.

notes: Reviewed interactively; approved after verification; merged in 22cea33d.
